properties.name: registry.rest.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the registry REST controllers (resources, resource types, search, versions, schemas, dump/restore, ResourceSync, typed records). The registry adds no authentication: when enabled, the application must guard these paths in its own security configuration.

properties.name: registry.rest.typed-resources-controller.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the typed records controller (/records/**). Has no effect when registry.rest.enabled is false.

properties.name: registry.rest.allow-encoded-slash
properties.description: Whether to accept URL-encoded slashes (%2F) in /records/** IDs and in registry.rest.encoded-slash-paths.

properties.name: registry.rest.encoded-slash-paths
properties.description: Extra path prefixes, besides 'records', where the Spring Security firewall accepts %2F when registry.rest.allow-encoded-slash is true.

properties.name: registry.host
properties.description: Public base URL used in ResourceSync documents. When unset, the URL of the current request is used.
